glosses: The vibration of an aircraft when flying in or approaching a stall, caused by separation of airflow from the aircraft's wings.

examples.text: The aircraft configuration was such that there was little or no warning of the stall onset. Since the roll to the left began at V₂ + 6 and since the pilots were aware that V₂ was well above the aircraft's stall speed, they probably did not suspect that the roll to the left indicated a stall. examples.text: Mr. Brandon shook his head in despair at the unbusinesslike methods of his patron.
